Definition: to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay
BiblicalUsage: Chalash means to weaken, to overthrow, to cut down. Joshua discomfited Amalek with the edge of the sword, Job says man dies and wastes away, and Isaiah taunts the fallen morning star: how are you cut down to the ground, you who weakened the nations?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe weakening is the end of every proud strength: Amalek weakened, man wasted away, and the star that weakened nations was cut down to the ground. The sword discomfits, the grave wastes, and pride falls — all by the same word.
